title: polanisia viscosa var. icosandra
intro: Polanisia viscosa var. icosandra, commonly known as Clammy Clover, is a plant species in the family Cleomaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Clammy Clover include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of Clammy Clover have been found to possess antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
